botanical_source: Pinned WCVP 65bed76bae9d644ccb6ad200c05f9f5071d89e05; 689 botanical family IDs via https://github.com/zuizui0223/chocho/actions/runs/38150410940
design: Four source portfolios evaluated using the same botanical pool and plant family x mean climate (BIO1 BIO12) x seasonal climate proxies (BIO7 BIO15) x WGSRPD2 geography fixed-margin double-edge swap chains. Frozen plant-native extents and all butterfly host identities within each scenario.
interpretation: Positive but very small conditional geographic excess of native-resource overlap, ca. 0.07–0.10 percentage points; most of apparent change when BCE sources are added is expected from expanded documented host links and not statistically resolved as a new spatial sorting effect.
claim_boundary: Post-hoc. Null retains severe mobility restrictions (~6% focal plant introduction edges displaced at final checkpoint) and correlated chains. Does not measure realized larval host use, fitness, butterfly demographic colonization, seasonally suitable tissues, or source-complete ecology. No change to GEB submission PR #38 or journal materials.
